implementation: Administration gets maintenance, incident-update and recovery notices with an explicit plain-text review and separate send action.

Server requires authenticated bounded dispatch, current durable admin authority, successful audit append and another role/session check after storage. Closed 1024-byte request schema; 220-byte public text; UTC update within 24 hours except optional recovery update; 3-token/minute connection budget.
Exact public copy, kind and timing use existing activity retention/journal. Public server chat is global across town, dungeon and casino; private actor/request identity is omitted.
Timeouts never resend automatically. History explicitly records admission, not guaranteed delivery. Notices do not change player state, stop the service, send email, or replay to later logins.

Operator procedure covers six incident classes, safe checks, stop/escalation conditions, communication and scope-specific reopening evidence. Owner staffing, external status destination and tabletop acceptance remain open.
